mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES remains near its current trough while TRANSIT stays depressed, weekday trips into Manhattan stay weak and retail-and-recreation mobility will remain below its prior four-week average over the next month.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES stayed around -50 to -54 and TRANSIT around -53 to -57 across the snapshot
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT stay at or below their current levels for four more weeks but RETAIL_REC rises above its last-four-week mean, this mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained improvement in GROCERY_PHARM indicates more errand-based local movement, and that spillover lifts nearby retail visits within one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM increases by at least 3 points from its recent weekly mean
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM moved from -28.3 to -24.4 in the snapshot
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM rises by 3 or more points and RETAIL_REC does not improve within the next two weeks, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS recovers while RESIDENTIAL stays elevated, discretionary outdoor circulation and neighborhood spending broaden, producing a four-week lift in retail-and-recreation mobility.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above -15 and RESIDENTIAL remains above +10
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved to -16.3 before reverting, while RESIDENTIAL stayed near +14
failure_condition: If PARKS stays above -15 and RESIDENTIAL stays above +10 for two consecutive weeks but RETAIL_REC does not rise over the next four weeks, reject.

mechanism_narrative: Under renewed restriction tightening, a further drop in TRANSIT is transmitted to retail footfall quickly because fewer in-person trips convert into fewer shopping visits within one week.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT is already near -54 and has been below -56 in most weeks
failure_condition: If TRANSIT falls below -58 and RETAIL_REC does not decline in the following week relative to its recent mean, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in WORKPLACES without a matching rebound in TRANSIT means more remote-to-office substitution than true commuting expansion, so retail mobility stays flat or declines over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises while TRANSIT remains below -55
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -54.0 to -50.1 while TRANSIT remained deeply negative
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES rises but TRANSIT remains below -55 and RETAIL_REC nevertheless rises over the next four weeks, the mechanism fails.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained uptick in PARKS mobility acts as a warm-weather proxy for discretionary outings; when it persists for two weeks, retail-and-recreation mobility increases soon after.
candidate_trigger: PARKS increases for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved in t-1w relative to earlier weeks before weakening at t-0w
failure_condition: If PARKS rises for two straight weeks and RETAIL_REC does not improve within two weeks, reject the hypothesis.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both recover together after a low-activity period, the combined commuting network restores downtown exposure and raises retail visitation over the following month.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises by 3 points and WORKPLACES rises by 3 points within the same week
evidence_refs: fact:Both series moved in the same direction at t-0w relative to t-1w
failure_condition: If TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both rise by at least 3 points in the same week but RETAIL_REC does not rise over the next four weeks, reject.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL activity stays elevated while GROCERY_PHARM remains weak, households are staying home without expanding local errand frequency, which suppresses retail visits over the next month.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL stays above +12 and GROCERY_PHARM stays below -20
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL is around +13 to +14 while GROCERY_PHARM is around -24 to -29
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL stays above +12 and GROCERY_PHARM stays below -20 for four weeks but RETAIL_REC rises above its last-four-week mean, the hypothesis is rejected.
